name: ZooCrew at Buttonwood Park Zoo
description_short: Summer ZooCrew is a week-long day camp at Buttonwood Park Zoo in New Bedford for ages 4 to 12 in four age groups, with a different animal or nature theme each week. Days run 9am to 4pm (half day 9 to noon for ages 4-5) with crafts, games, activities, animal encounters and recess in the Nature Play area. Lunch can be bought for $10 a day or packed.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations are accepted until the week before your child's start date. After that there are no refunds, except for cancellations due to a Covid diagnosis.

sources.note: ZooCrew page: Summer ZooCrew July-August, ages 4-12, $350/week full day, $175 half day (ages 4-5), lunch $10 or bring, scholarships, cancellation policy, registration starts March 1, 2026
Summer ZooCrew registration: 12 one-week sessions starting Mondays 7/6-8/10/2026 ('Children can be registered for one week increments'), $350 full day week; several marked Sold Out

warnings: All dates on the page are for the 2026 season and have already passed (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is posted yet.
Winter and spring prices ($240) were worked out from $60/day x 4 days. They are not printed as totals on the page.
Summer session prices show the full-day rate ($350/week). Half day ($175/week) is only for 4- and 5-year-olds, who must be potty-trained.
Members get 15% off. Prices shown are non-member rates.
The summer scholarship window is labeled 'Deadline' but listed as 'February 1st – May 31st'.
Lunch is $10/day unless you pack one. Lunch is included for scholarship recipients.
The 4-5 age group overlaps with the 6-7 group in the week of 7/13. The page says each age group overlaps with another once.
12 sessions without full dates were left out
